meta.description: University outreach programs and community engagement of the Universidad Nacional de Concepción.

hero.label: Engagement with society
hero.title: University outreach
hero.description: UNC goes beyond the classroom to actively contribute to the human, cultural and productive development of the Concepción region.

p1.descripcion: Courses, workshops and diploma programs open to the community for the ongoing training of professionals and citizens.

p2.descripcion: Programs where students and faculty bring knowledge and services to rural and indigenous communities in the department.

p3.descripcion: Cultural activities, exhibitions, choirs and artistic groups that connect the university with the social fabric of Concepción.

p4.descripcion: Oral health brigades, preventive medicine and vaccination campaigns coordinated with the Ministry of Public Health.

p5.descripcion: Legal guidance service for low-income individuals, delivered by law students under faculty supervision.

p6.descripcion: Technical support for rural producers in the region on good agricultural practices, animal health and soil management.
